title: Dublin Avenue / Martin Luther King Jr. Boulevard / Weiland Avenue / Obama Boulevard / Coliseum Street / Roundabout Bollards / Blinking Lights Around Stop Signs / Adding Four-Way Stops / Quick-Build Treatments
motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the Council INSTRUCT the LADOT to report back with recommendations on quick-build treatments within the area bounded by Dublin Avenue, Martin Luther King Jr. Boulevard, Weiland Avenue, and Obama Boulevard/Coliseum Street, including but not limited to: roundabout bollards placed in the middle of an intersection; blinking lights around stop signs at an intersection; replacing two-way stops with four- way stops; updating street and curb markings with paint; partial closures to vehicles; speed tables/humps; and median extensions. I FURTHER MOVE that $100,000 in the Council District 10 portion of the Council Discretionary Street Furniture Fund No. 43D, Dept. 50 be transferred/ appropriated to the Department of Transportation Trust Fund Dept. 94, Fund 840, New Account with Title Leimert Park Bikeable and Walkable Communities Strategic Plan". I FURTHER MOVE that the Department of Transportation be authorized to make any corrections, clarifications or revisions to the above fund transfer instructions, including any new instructions, in order to effectuate the intent of this Motion, and including any corrections and changes to fund or account numbers; said corrections / clarifications/ changes may be made orally, electronically or by any other means. PRESENTED BY: Health Hutt HEATHER HUTT R Councilmember, 10th District RECEIVING SECONDED BY: Enisss MAS Ronard OCT 2 8 2026
